what: acceptance of the erratum-004 carrier: Vivado rebuild, the publication chain, three gates, and a fresh clone in both a cold and a hot LFS tree

build.pblock: SLICE_X0Y0:SLICE_X1Y99 + SLICE_X6Y0:SLICE_X7Y99, IS_SOFT false, PRIMITIVE_COUNT 1849, all 1981 cells carry PBLOCK

cost_of_the_readback_sequencer.reading: comfortable. The floorplan is two segments of about 1,600 LUTs and 400 slices; 305 slices are occupied. Timing is met with 5.75 ns of slack at 50 MHz FCLK0

local_map_note: byte-identical to the erratum-003 run's: the map is a property of the device, not of the carrier
publication_order: copy build outputs + maps/clb_lut_init_v1.local_map.json into the run root
commit the AUTHORITY half alone (4b47af2): PRODUCTION_MANIFEST_SHA256 and the six files bound to the run id
gate_carrier_base.py and gate_init_eco.py, which require the run in HEAD

gates.gate_publish_carrier_run: PUBLISHABLE — every pinned artifact staged, every LFS pointer's oid equal to the bundle's pin, every ordinary blob hashing to it, staged change set exactly the run root
gates.gate_carrier_base: ACCEPTED — the manifest's base is the final routed carrier bitstream, routed, cell isolation passed, all 8 bundled artifacts match their pinned digests
gates.gate_init_eco: ACCEPTED — 2 of 5144 frames differ, exactly the 2 the map predicts; 3 predicted bits moved, no stray bits, every ECC a correct recomputation

fresh_clone_hot.how: git clone <repo> — the LFS smudge filter materialises the artifacts during checkout
fresh_clone_hot.skip_reason: every skip is a specimen bitstream under build/, which is gitignored — none of them is a carrier test

fresh_clone_cold.how: GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone <repo> — the three binaries stay 132-byte pointers
fresh_clone_cold.gate_carrier_base: REFUSED, exit 2: 'carrier.bit does not match the build record', actual 3b9d263c… (the pointer's own bytes), and the same for post_route.dcp
fresh_clone_cold.reading: an unmaterialised tree cannot exercise the authority and says so loudly instead of passing. This is the check that a run published as LFS is still verifiable rather than merely present

not_done: no board time — the board still has fault_since_reset and recovery_required latched from the erratum-003 calibration, so a reload or power cycle is the first act of any session
